presentation.label: DIGIHEALTH
presentation.summary: SYSTEM INFO shows CPU, DSP and free RAM in the top bar.
presentation.overview: digihealth adds SYSTEM INFO to SETTINGS on the original Digitone and Digitone Keys running OS 1.43. The top bar alternates main-CPU load and audio-render current/peak load with free heap RAM. The DSP label measures effects and mixing on the main CPU; the FM voices run on the second CPU and their load is not shown. Digitone has no sample-memory readout, and this port has no FAST AUDIO setting. A read-only USB SysEx diagnostics channel uses device byte 0x7D.
highlights: SYSTEM INFO alternates load and free-RAM pages every two seconds.
DSP shows effects/mix render load and its last-second peak, rather than the second CPU’s FM voice load.
Read-only USB diagnostics are available; FAST AUDIO is a Digitakt-only feature.
usage: Open SETTINGS, tick SYSTEM INFO and return to a pattern with a few FM tracks.
Play the pattern. Read CPU and DSP current/peak figures, then wait for free RAM; the top-bar pages alternate every two seconds.
Keep the notes unchanged and adjust a delay or reverb send to observe the effects/mix workload. DSP does not show the separate FM voice CPU’s load.
Stop playback, restore the example send settings and untick SYSTEM INFO in SETTINGS to return to the normal top bar. There is no FAST AUDIO toggle on this port.

steps: Use a build containing the Digitone port of digihealth on an original Digitone or Digitone Keys with OS 1.43.
Open SETTINGS and tick SYSTEM INFO.
Return to a pattern to view the alternating load and free-RAM figures in the top bar; untick SYSTEM INFO to hide them.

controls.name: SYSTEM INFO
controls.doc: Tick in SETTINGS to alternate CPU and audio-render DSP current/last-second peak with free heap RAM every two seconds. DSP covers the main CPU’s effects and mix; the separate FM voice CPU is not measured. Untick to hide the readout.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

tests.summary: Imported from the author’s v1.1 source; Modwerk linked and verified the pinned catalog release for the UI documentation run. Documentation captures verify the listed UI pages on OS 1.43; audio, timing and hardware remain unqualified.
